final_integration.note: No integrated acceptance yet; previous stage results do not validate all current changes.

module_results.note: Same numerical oracle inputs replayed against latest source, not new independent samples.

empty_previous_suite.note: Older empty-bypass-only build; not final integrated acceptance.

completion_wait_first_probe.scope: Only this app; no general absence-of-blocking claim.

wait_profile_results.note: No head-of-line blocking with ready younger source in these five programs. Directed divide-produced seed probe added; general bottleneck conclusion pending.

seed_lookahead_stage.note: Current RTL newer than gap_final matrix; that matrix remains valid for its frozen pre-lookahead source only.

initial_soc_observation.note: Compute/ownership waiting improved but this program window did not; no speedup claim.

seed_lookahead_stage.observer_note: v1 generic Word HOLD/output counters include internal background HOLD; use seed_lookahead and VALU pending counters there. v2 corrects observer to compute pointer and actual result_valid, no RTL change.

historical_status_notes.restart_status: First implementation compiled; 9/9 directed mixed SoC tests passed, broader profiling and regression incomplete
historical_status_notes.initial_probe_issue: Uninitialized scalar reduction result in both configurations; preserved v1 ELF/logs and stopped after failure. Fully initialized-register v2 comparison running; cause unproven.
historical_status_notes.exact_decouple_status: 2400 early Slide packet cases, 2400 paired-frame replays (4800 results), and 10/10 directed SoC tests passed; broad integrated regression pending
historical_status_notes.fp_late_status: FP extrema and FP64 source-only local phase with versioned seed binding implemented; initial same-ELF chains passed on/off; ordinary vector producers and full heterogeneous matrix remain outstanding
historical_status_notes.ordinary_seed_status: Seven directed SoC tests and 4-result protocol test passed. Same-VFU integer cycles unchanged; same-VFU FP regresses 1386->1482. Cross-VFU benchmark running; cost-aware eligibility and full integrated regression outstanding.

current_status: Latest combined106 passed with exact expected set and frozen simulator/ELF/log classification verified; current8 functional files match frozen build; remaining scope audit outstanding

exact_fallthrough_stage.fix: Transparent empty completed-result slot; hold on backpressure and preserve ordered replacement. Uses the existing exact_decouple switch.
exact_fallthrough_stage.note: Latest source is newer than the completed phase-one ablations and pending phase-two full suite. Preserve those frozen results; targeted exact-path validation is in progress.
exact_fallthrough_stage.runner_configuration_error: ready_v1 requested trailing Slide with OUTPUT_HOLD=0, which the TB rejects before execution; preserved as a driver configuration failure. ready_v2 removes trailing Slide and requires observed fallthrough.

known_failure.symptom: CVA6 branch operand unknown assertions at 885.5/901.5 ns; scalar trace shows slide_out[24] and slide_out[28] contain X. Core success text is not acceptance.
known_failure.status: investigating; original ELF and failure retained

initial_cycle_comparison.note: Performance result does not override directed correctness failure.

diagnosis.finding: SLDU writes contain correct 7 values; lane.sv selects grant using source egress FIFO head, which can advance to FPU before remaining Slide writes are accepted. Normal Slide result requests must use operand_requester grant regardless of the current source selector.
diagnosis.patch: sldu_result_req_i overrides the source selector when choosing the result grant
diagnosis.validation: same ELF: buggy v1 checker catches invalid acknowledgement; fixed v2 has blocked token-ready collision and zero invalid acknowledgements, test passes; full affected suite pending

input_error.cause: Slide glob also selected disassembly text; non-ELF run is a driver failure, retained in original manifest

v2_results.extra_slide_isa: vslideup fails with 5 reported mismatches both before and after Lane grant fix, same ELF; independent existing failure remains deferred

fp64_seed_feedback_stage.status: 5000 module cases and 13 directed SoC programs per side passed; default disabled, limited application gain
fp64_seed_feedback_stage.scope: final physical lane return to already bound non-embedded seed; preserves sequential FP adds; inactive tail lanes unchanged
fp64_seed_feedback_stage.note: Randomized handshake timing evolves with completion timing; module cycle totals are not an application speedup.

word_sparse_stage.status: 20000 module cases and seven SoC programs per side passed; explicit profile enabled
word_sparse_stage.scope: integer MERGE selects next active lane, retaining lane0 accumulator and seed; no extra arithmetic datapath
word_sparse_stage.observer_boundary: Frozen v1 word event13 reads cursor, not selected sparse merge lane; corrected only in current observer, not historical logs.

queue_capacity_stage.note: No added queue beyond existing configurable implementation; do not infer area/Fmax or adopt new default before validation.
queue_capacity_stage.scope: Queue setting verified on newest source with sparse and FP64 seed feedback disabled; combined sparse profile still needs integration.

hypotheses: Slide and Word RCE share sequencer queue credits until architectural retirement
SLDU/RCE completion pulses are serialized to protect single decrement counter
shared_resource_stage.scope: read-only; sole_queue_limit excludes only other FU queue limits, not register or mask hazards; predicates overlap
shared_resource_stage.decision: Do not add communication network or change ownership before profiling.
shared_resource_stage.next_action: Study independent Word and SLDU admission accounting with bounded contexts; exact/Slide still share transport and cannot be freed by Word-only split.

split_credit_stage.scope: Word-only independent two-context reservations; unchanged SLDU depth, completion serialization, ID retirement and shared data path
invariants: at most two dispatched Word IDs
at most three Word reservations including one blocked frontend request
existing RCE command capacity assertion retained
split_credit_stage.pending_probe: completed both sides; integer scalar and all four Slide vectors checked
split_credit_stage.observer_note: v1 freezes pre-word_credit observer; current observer adds explicit admission counters for subsequent builds

combined_completion_stage.note: FP64 seed feedback remains off due limited measured gain; correctness deferrals unchanged.

sldu_buffer_stage.scope: 2 versus 4 descriptors and matching sequencer credits; result data queue stays 2, no new network/arithmetic
sldu_buffer_stage.note: Experimental off by default; combined99 run predates this parameterization and retains 2 descriptors.

final_completion_stage.note: Final selected profile now includes 4 SLDU descriptors; old combined99 is a separate 2-descriptor snapshot.

residual_wait_stage.purpose: Measure complete younger source/seed behind output backpressure before considering more completion scheduling state
residual_wait_stage.rtl: same frozen final candidate; read-only completion_wait and shared resource binds added
residual_wait_stage.decision: Retain output-backpressure scheduling limitation; one observed opportunity in this set does not justify extra result/checkpoint ownership state. No universal absence claim.

required_followup: Complete requirement audit including remaining coverage and scheduling gaps
Review and commit intended artifacts; do not push without instruction
architecture_boundaries: Ordered floating-point reductions retain strict original order
Ordinary late seed is restricted to validated unmasked non-restarted arithmetic producers and cross-VFU eligibility by default
Output-backpressure background computation is not implemented; final eight-program profiling found only one eligible cycle
No synthesis, area, Fmax, or power measurement per user instruction
deferred_correctness: vslideup ISA counterexample also present before the Lane grant fix
completion_audit.documentation_reconciliation: Current-boundary table updated for sparse FP64, external seed, and historical99/current106 distinction

parallel_retire_stage.scope: Only Word and SLDU may retire together; exact remains SLDU class; actual VRF grant and all Lane ownership readiness still required
parallel_retire_stage.note: v1 frozen builds predate new explicit simultaneous-retire counter and legacy-credit assertions; those will need instrumented validation. Existing final99 remains its frozen pre-change snapshot.

first_performance.decision: Keep off; local mutual exclusion removal regresses this workload, not an accepted optimization

parallel_retire_stage.decision: rejected and removed from selected RTL; preserved as patch because measured cycle regression

final_performance.baseline: gap_final_control_v1: earlier RCE optimized configuration, not official Ara
final_performance.source_scope: same ELF/peripherals/measurement windows; multiple RTL mechanisms differ, use individual ablations for attribution

fp64_sparse_stage.note: Previous final99 covers earlier frozen RTL, not this new experiment. Same active-lane add order; SoC benefit unverified.

without_feedback_module.scope: Sparse selector independent of return-to-input feedback

findings: Load/Slide external grant accepts stream-register input, not actual VRF write
Delayed final grant does not identify current input payload
Current arithmetic seed ports carry version; Load/Slide lane inputs do not
writer_mfpu binary classification must not classify Load/Slide as same VALU
external_seed_interface_audit.next: Separate LMUL1 seed wait from LMUL4 group guard; assess precise eligible-seed exemption
external_seed_interface_audit.scope: 16 Load-to-FP64 reduction pairs at VL16/32/64 LMUL4; baseline measurement, no relaxed dependency yet
external_seed_interface_audit.causal_correction: LMUL4 producer versus scalar seed triggers p_reduction_group_guard before dispatch; zero hazard at dispatch does not exclude earlier avoidable wait
external_seed_interface_audit.m1_finding: All48 reductions have nonzero vs1 hazard; single-hazard46 per program receive seed6cycles after dispatch for Load,6..7for Slide; first compute3/2cycles later

seed_group_stage.scope: Only already-supported ordinary arithmetic versioned seed producer; preserve other overlap guards
seed_group_stage.reason: LMUL group destination vs scalar seed mismatch blocks prior to late-seed dispatch
seed_group_stage.validation: Not yet validated; full101 frozen build excludes this new stage

first_completed_app_cycles.scope: Completed ordinary-seed app; full10 suites still running

seed_group_stage.attribution: 16 additional eligible ordinary seed dispatches; same Word credit counters; source and defines identity verified

supported_producers: unmasked non-restarted VLE with nf0 and not fault_only_first
external_seed_stage.capture: actual buffered operand_requester VRF grant; base word only; per-ID destination version
external_seed_stage.validation: not yet verified; prior group10 and sparse101 frozen builds exclude this stage
external_seed_stage.first_build_failure: generate block inserted inside port list; moved to module body; failed v1 preserved
external_seed_stage.observer_fix: separate external candidate from same-VFU arithmetic label; no functional change
external_seed_stage.candidate_config: enabled in explicit candidate profile; full106 pending

full_regression.note: Uses RCE_STALL_PROFILE only; dormant external cycle-landmark observer not enabled. Functional overlays/config verified.

source_findings: Exact header receive currently waits for late seed
SLDU and Word seed caches have different ID lifetime rules

Implement per-consumer versioned seed retention and independent build switch
